messages:
maria.gomez: Starting a mini-burn for redwood-v3q-int4 on the 'bridge-cal' slice. Goal: validate latency fidelity and sample-level regressions before promoting to fractional traffic. Running 1k samples across high-variance prompts.
jonah: SGTM. Which metrics are we gating on for auto-fallback?
liam.k: Primary gate: end-to-end P95 latency (+>15% triggers degrade), secondary gate: macro-quality delta (LM-eval MRR drop > 1.5%), tertiary: hallucination rate on safety prompts (+>2% absolute). Also watch tokenization mismatch alerts.
sophia: Can we fold in a composite signal so small noisy drops don't auto-fallback? e.g., require 2 of 3 gates to trip within 10m window.
maria.gomez: Yep — propose composite rule: (latency_p95_delta > 15%) OR (quality_mrr_delta > 1.5% AND hallucination_delta > 1.0%) OR sustained error-rate spike (>0.5% 5m avg). If triggered => immediate rollback and notify oncall.
jonah: Cool. What's the miniburn run command? can we reproduce locally?
liam.k: Run locally: ```./eval_harness --model redwood-v3q-int4 --slices bridge-cal --n 1000 --metrics mrr,hallucination,latency --out /tmp/miniburn.json```
sophia: Extraction note: use the stable tokenizer build (tokenizer v2.1) — we've seen prefix mismatch when older tokenizers used with quantized kernels.
maria.gomez: Good call. I saw a tiny bias on longprompts slice, looks like KV cache warmup issue. Will run a separate cold-start slice.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: canary pool -> 2 nodes (a100-40g) at 2025-08-03T15:10Z. Healthchecks: /internal/health, perf-probe.
jonah: How large are the mini-burn cohorts per slice? we should ensure sample-level power.
liam.k: Using stratified sampling: 600 core prompts, 200 long-context, 200 edgecases. That gives ~85% power to detect 1.5% MRR drop.
sophia: Also enable shadow logging for token-level diffs for the first 200 requests so we can inspect prefix cache hits/misses. Add flag: `SHADOW_DIFF=1`.
maria.gomez: Running now. First 200 jobs queued. I'll paste interim logs when smoke completed.
(eval-bot): smokecheck: 200/200 samples OK; avg latency 82ms (baseline 71ms); p95 210ms (baseline 180ms); mrr delta +0.8% (improvement); hallucination +0.4% absolute.
jonah: p95 up ~16.6% — close to our threshold. But mrr improved. Composite rule would not auto-fallback yet. Any error spikes?
liam.k: No error-rate spike visible. Token-diff shows increased prefix misses for certain template prompts — likely kernel selection at sequence boundary.
sophia: Suggest patch: force kernel=optimized_seq with env override for canary to see if p95 improves. Try `KERNEL_HINT=optimized_seq`.
maria.gomez: Applying kernel hint to the two nodes now. Re-running the same 200 shadow requests.
(eval-bot): smokecheck: 200/200 samples OK; avg latency 74ms; p95 186ms; mrr delta +0.7%; hallucination +0.5%.
jonah: p95 down to ~3% over baseline now (186 vs 180). Good. Any persistent hallucination trend?
liam.k: Hallucination slight uptick but within noise. Recommend we proceed to 1% fractional traffic for 12h with continuous gate checks. If composite gate trips, rollback automatically.
sophia: Also add an hourly eval snapshot to the dashboard and alerting `#eng-ml` if MRR regresses >0.8% for two consecutive hours.
maria.gomez: Agreed. I'll update rollout policy: promote to 1% -> monitor 12h -> if stable, step to 10% with same gates. Setting rollout policy now.
deploy-bot: Canary promoted: 1% traffic at 2025-08-03T16:02Z. Monitoring hooks enabled.
maria.gomez: Thanks team. If anything weird pops, ping @oncall and mark the thread. I'll follow up with the full miniburn report in ~14h. :thumbsup:
